answer: Resist Sybils with reciprocal-interaction weight: a new identity starts weightless and earns standing only through sustained two-way exchanges with diverse established peers. Like an ocean fed by many small streams, trust accumulates drop by drop; one mesa of activity cannot substitute for breadth. Each fake must independently cultivate its own reciprocal history, and calendar time cannot be parallelized or shared — reaching the zenith of full standing takes as long for the hundredth fake as for the first.
